attrs.sql: INSERT INTO ORDER_ITEMS (ITEM_ID, ORDER_ID, PRODUCT_ID, QTY) SELECT ?, ?, P.PRODUCT_ID, ? FROM PRODUCTS P WHERE P.PRODUCT_ID = ?
INSERT INTO ORDERS (ORDER_ID, CUSTOMER_ID, STATUS) VALUES (SEQ_ORDER.NEXTVAL, ?, ?)
SELECT * FROM ORDERS O JOIN ORDER_ITEMS I ON I.ORDER_ID = O.ORDER_ID WHERE O.ORDER_ID = ?
SELECT O.ORDER_ID, O.STATUS, C.NAME FROM ORDERS O JOIN CUSTOMERS C ON C.CUSTOMER_ID = O.CUSTOMER_ID

MERGE INTO SETTLEMENTS S USING (SELECT CUSTOMER_ID, COUNT(*) CNT FROM ORDERS GROUP BY CUSTOMER_ID) O ON (S.CUSTOMER_ID = O.CUSTOMER_ID) WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET S.CNT = O.CNT WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT (CUSTOMER_ID, CNT) VALUES (O.CUSTOMER_ID, O.CNT)
INSERT INTO ORDER_HISTORY (ORDER_ID, CLOSED_AT) SELECT ORDER_ID, SYSDATE FROM ORDERS WHERE ORDER_ID = P_ORDER_ID
UPDATE ORDERS SET STATUS = 'CLOSED' WHERE ORDER_ID = P_ORDER_ID
